title: 第515章 师兄弟对打
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“主人，让俺来对付大师兄吧。”

此刻，浑天大圣则对着云峰说道，要知道如此大圣可是云峰的奴隶，云峰是大圣的主人。

对浑天大圣而言，眼前的这个三眼真君既然要和主人为敌，那么就算他是大圣的师兄，那也是大圣的敌人了。

浑天大圣自然是要站在主人这边的。

“也好，你来对付你大师兄，二师姐我们去一边看戏去。”

云峰点了点头，则带着二师姐马蓉去了旁边空旷一点的地方，他还拿出了两包瓜子来，自己一包，二师姐一包，打算嗑瓜子看戏了。

再看浑天大圣已经从耳朵里取出来了金箍棒，他站在了三眼真君的面前。

“二师弟，你确定要和我动手？要知道我们同门学艺这么多年，我们不知道比武斗法多少次了，从小打到大，你哪一次打得过我？你真的为了这个外人要和大师兄为敌？”

三眼真君看着浑天大圣冷冷地道。

三眼真君和浑天大圣都是小时候被紫阳真人带到紫阳派学艺的，两人从小一起长大，同门了起码上百年了，两人也经常比武斗法，正如同三眼真君说的那样，浑天大圣的确要逊色一些，不是三眼真君的对手，浑天大圣从来没打赢过三眼真君。

“呵呵，打不过也要打，谁让你要和主人为敌的。”

浑天大圣也怒了，挥舞了一下手里的金箍棒，棒子直接旋转了起来，散发出来道道金光。

“二师弟，那既然这样，你动手吧，别怪师兄不留情面。”

三眼真君叹了口气，不过也没办法了，他想要击杀云峰，那么只能先杀掉二师弟大圣。

“吃俺一棒。”

浑天大圣不再废话，抡起金箍棒朝着三眼真君狠狠地轰了过来，三眼真君也是抡起方天画戟格挡了。

三眼真君和浑天大圣都是二类渡劫修士，两人的力量恐怖如斯，两件兵器在碰撞的时候都发出了巨大的声响，地面层层龟裂，出现了蜘蛛网一样的裂缝。

云峰和二师姐马蓉哪怕距离他们有上百米远，也感受到了如此庞大的力量，二师姐马蓉都差点摔倒了，幸亏云峰一把将其搀扶起来了。

再看现场，浑天大圣已经和三眼真君大战起来了。

两人武器对碰了不到十下，浑天大圣就一棍子砸在了三眼真君的脸上。

三眼真君顿时被轰得飞了出去几十米远，重重地轰在了旁边的一处山崖上，将山崖轰了个稀巴烂。

三眼真君更是趴在地上，嘴里冒出了鲜血来。

“二师弟，你境界提升了？”

三眼真君爬起来用手擦拭了一下嘴边的血，看着浑天大圣说道，他这才发现浑天大圣的境界不知道什么时候提升到了二类渡劫后期了，以前大圣可是在前期的。

“没错，因为主人给我服用了仙丹，所以我提升了境界。”

浑天大圣笑嘻嘻的，一棒子把大师兄砸飞出去，他感觉好过瘾，当然他也知道这是因为他服用了仙丹，境界提升了才能打赢大师兄的，不然的话他再修炼一百年也别想伤到大师兄。

“呵呵，就算你提升了又如何，你也不是我的对手。二师弟，你忘记了我最厉害的本事了吗？现在让你看看我的手段。”

Page (1/3)

"Master, let me deal with senior brother."

At this moment, the Great Sage Huntian said to Yunfeng, you must know that such a great sage is Yunfeng's slave, and Yunfeng is the great sage's master.

To the Great Sage Huntian, since the Three-Eyed True Lord in front of him wants to be the enemy of his master, then even if he is the Great Sage's senior brother, he is also the Great Sage's enemy.

The Great Sage Hun Tian naturally wants to stand on the master's side.

"Okay, you deal with your senior brother, and second senior sister, let's go watch a show."

Yunfeng nodded and took his second senior sister Ma Rong to a more open area nearby. He also took out two packs of melon seeds, one for himself and one for his second senior sister, intending to eat melon seeds and watch the show.

Then he saw that the Great Sage Huntian had taken out the golden cudgel from his ear, and he stood in front of the Three-Eyed True Monarch.

"Second Junior Brother, are you sure you want to fight me? You have to know that we have been studying together for so many years. We have competed in martial arts countless times. We have fought since we were young. How have you ever been able to beat me? Do you really want to make an enemy of your senior brother for this outsider?"

The Three-Eyed True Monarch looked at the Great Sage Huntian and said coldly.

Both Three-Eyed True Monarch and Huntian Monarch were brought to Ziyang Sect to learn martial arts by Master Ziyang when they were young. They grew up together and have been in the same sect for at least a hundred years. They often competed in martial arts. As Three-Eyed Monarch said, Huntian Monarch is indeed inferior and is not the opponent of Three-Eyed True Monarch. Huntian Monarch has never defeated Three-Eyed True Monarch.

"Haha, you have to fight even if you can't beat him. Who told you to be the enemy of the master?"

The Great Sage Huntian was also angry and waved the golden hoop in his hand. The stick spun directly and emitted streaks of golden light.

"Second Junior Brother, if that's the case, go ahead and do it. Don't blame Senior Brother for being ruthless."

The Three-Eyed Lord sighed, but there was nothing he could do. If he wanted to kill Yunfeng, he could only kill the second junior brother, the Great Sage first.

"Take a stick from me."

The Great Sage Huntian stopped talking nonsense, picked up the golden cudgel, and struck hard at the Three-Eyed True Monarch. The Three-Eyed True Monarch also picked up the Fangtian Painted Halberd to block.

The Three-Eyed True Monarch and the Great Sage Huntian were both Category II Tribulation Transcendence monks. Their power was so terrifying that the two weapons made a huge sound when they collided. The ground cracked layer by layer, and cracks like spider webs appeared.

Yunfeng and Second Senior Sister Ma Rong felt such a huge force even though they were hundreds of meters away from them. Second Senior Sister Ma Rong almost fell down. Fortunately, Yunfeng helped her up.

Looking at the scene again, the Great Sage Huntian was already fighting with the Three-Eyed True Monarch.

The two weapons clashed less than ten times before the Great Sage Huntian hit the Three-Eyed True Monarch in the face with a stick.

The Three-Eyed Lord was immediately blasted dozens of meters away, and hit a nearby cliff heavily, smashing the cliff into pieces.

The Three-Eyed True Monarch lay on the ground with blood coming out of his mouth.

"Second Junior Brother, has your level improved?"

The Three-Eyed True Monarch got up and wiped the blood from his mouth with his hand, looked at the Great Sage Huntian and said, only then did he realize that the realm of the Great Sage Huntian had been promoted to the late stage of the second category of tribulation. The previous Great Sage was in the early stage.

"Yes, because the master gave me the elixir, I improved my level."

The Great Sage Huntian smiled and smashed the senior brother away with a stick. He felt so good. Of course, he also knew that it was because he had taken the elixir and his level had improved that he could defeat the senior brother. Otherwise, he would not be able to hurt the senior brother if he practiced for another hundred years.

"Haha, so what if you improve, you are still no match for me. Second Junior Brother, have you forgotten my most powerful ability? Now let me show you my methods."
